newsitem.title: USA: PXRE says pressure on premiums to continue.
newsitem.headline: PXRE says pressure on premiums to continue.

text.p: PXRE Corp said Wednesday it continues to see a great deal of pressure on premiums written at the current time, as indicated by the decline in premium volume from pro forma amounts last year.

The company said this environment underscores the importance of its strategies, particularly its recent merger with Transnational Re, which already has begun to result in more efficient operations, lower costs. The merger has also improved the position of its investment portfolio and capital management transactions, it said.

Earlier PXRE reported results for the first quarter ended March 31, which was marked by "a continuation of an intensely competitive environment" and an absence of major catastrophic events - conditions that have characterized the past two annual renewal seasons.
